spans.s: N. of an Apsaras (mother of Śakuntalā).

N. of the wife of Himālaya.
.━{@Comp.@}: मेनकात्मजा
N. of the wife of Himālaya; मेनां मुनीनामपि माननीयाम् (उपयेमे)

मेन्धिका, -मेन्धी
 N. of a plant (Mar. मेंदी) (from the leaves of which
 a reddish dye is extracted, wherewith to colour the tips and nails of
 fingers, the soles of the feet, and the palms of the hand).
